name: Guanajuato

standard.note: Guanajuato's plate has blue stripes, the state shield top left, a QR code top right, and the motto 'Grandeza de México' along the bottom.

plates.title: Current design (2020)
plates.fact: Guanajuato's plate has blue stripes, the state shield top left, a QR code top right, and the motto 'Grandeza de México' along the bottom.

notes: The statewide canje of this design began 1 Sep 2020 (placas2020.guanajuato.gob.mx, per UnoTV) and added double-layer QR security. No official plate image was found on boletines.guanajuato.gob.mx. No special or commemorative private-car designs were found; Guanajuato did not issue World Cup plates (adn40, Apr 2026). Not checked: disability or antique-car plates.
